mapper.select: select * from platform_customer_service where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id desc limit 200
select * from platform_customer_service where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
select * from platform_customer_service where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into platform_customer_service (tenant_id, name, config_json, revision, status, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{configJson}, 1, 'ACTIVE', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into platform_customer_release (id, tenant_id, app_id, source_revision, config_json, model_hash, speech_model_hash, playback_model_hash, create_by, create_time) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{sourceRevision}, #{configJson}, #{modelHash}, #{speechModelHash}, #{playbackModelHash}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from platform_customer_release where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into platform_customer_session (id, tenant_id, app_id, release_id, user_id, runtime_epoch, status, turn_count, create_time, expires_at, channel_id, channel_revision, visitor_token_hash) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{releaseId}, #{userId}, #{runtimeEpoch}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createTime}, #{expiresAt}, #{channelId}, #{channelRevision}, #{visitorTokenHash})
mapper.select: select * from platform_customer_session where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and user_id = #{userId} and id = #{id}
select * from platform_customer_session where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and user_id = #{userId} and id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update platform_customer_session set status = 'CLOSED' where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and user_id = #{userId} and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from platform_customer_turn where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and session_id = #{sessionId} order by turn_no limit 50
select * from platform_customer_turn where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and session_id = #{sessionId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into platform_customer_turn (id, tenant_id, session_id, request_id, turn_no, question, status, create_time, deadline) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{turnNo}, #{question}, 'RUNNING', #{createTime}, #{deadline})
mapper.select: select count(*) from platform_customer_speech where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and status='RUNNING' and deadline > #{now}
